caseNameFull: Dombrowski v. Pfister, Chairman, Joint Legislative Committee on Un-American Activities of the Louisiana Legislature
attorneys: Jack N. Rogers and Robert H. Reiter for appellees on the motion.

opinions.text:
(Probable jurisdiction noted, 377 U. S. 976.) The motion to dismiss is postponed pending the hearing on the merits.

Mr. Justice Black took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
